title: leucanthemopsis alpina subsp. cuneata
intro: Leucanthemopsis alpina subsp. cuneata, commonly known as Alpine Cushion Daisy, is a plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Leucanthemopsis alpina subsp. cuneata include antimicrobial, antifungal, and antiviral activities, which can aid in the treatment of various infections and diseases. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
